# Environment reference

Every setting is declared in a [Varlock](https://varlock.dev) `.env.schema`: the root `.env.schema` holds shared keys, and each app or package has its own for the keys only it reads. This page is generated from those files (`bun run docs:env`); CI fails when it is stale.

Set values in `deploy/.env` (Docker Compose passes the whole file to every service) or in a gitignored `.env` at the repo root for development. Optional services switch on when their keys are present. Secrets are marked, and Varlock redacts them in logs.

Keys you will usually set first: `APP_URL`, `API_URL`, then the secrets that `deploy/generate-secrets.sh` creates for you.

## Core

URLs, secrets and instance behaviour.

### `NODE_ENV`

type `enum(development, test, production)`

Node runtime mode. Usually set by the runtime/tooling (Next.js, Docker image).

### `APP_ENV`

type `enum(development, test, staging, production)` · default `fallback($NODE_ENV, development)`

Deployment environment; selects `.env.<APP_ENV>` overrides. Defaults to NODE_ENV, then `development`. Production enables scheduled maintenance jobs.

### `APP_URL`

**required** · type `url` · e.g. `http://localhost:3001`

Public URL of the dashboard, e.g. https://app.example.com

### `API_URL`

**required** · type `url` · e.g. `http://localhost:3003`

Public URL of the API, e.g. https://api.example.com

### `DEFAULT_COUNTRY`

Fallback country (ISO 3166 alpha-2, e.g. SE) when neither Cloudflare geo headers nor Accept-Language identify one.

### `DEFAULT_TIMEZONE`

Fallback IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Berlin) when the request has no timezone header and the user/team has none set.

### `API_INTERNAL_URL`

type `url` · default `$API_URL`

URL the dashboard server uses to reach the API (e.g. a private network address). Defaults to API_URL.

### `ALLOWED_API_ORIGINS`

Comma-separated extra origins allowed by API CORS (APP_URL is always allowed).

### `SUPPORT_EMAIL`

Support contact shown on error pages. Hidden when unset.

### `DESKTOP_RELEASES_URL`

type `url`

Releases page of your fork where the desktop app is published (for example https://github.com/you/midday/releases/latest). Shows the "Midday Desktop" card in the app store; hidden when unset.

### `DESKTOP_SCHEME`

default `midday`

Deep-link scheme registered by the desktop app (midday, midday-dev, ...).

### `MIDDAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY`

**required** · secret · type `string(minLength=64, maxLength=64)`

32-byte hex key (64 chars) used to encrypt OAuth tokens and other secrets at rest. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

### `FILE_KEY_SECRET`

**required** · secret

Secret used to sign file access keys. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

### `INVOICE_JWT_SECRET`

**required** · secret

Secret used to sign public invoice links. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

### `INTERNAL_API_KEY`

**required** · secret

Shared key for service-to-service calls (worker/dashboard -> API). Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

## Database

Postgres (with pgvector and pg_trgm).

### `DATABASE_URL`

**required** · secret · type `url` · e.g. `postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/midday`

Postgres connection string (primary).

### `DATABASE_REPLICA_URLS`

secret

Optional comma-separated read replica connection strings.

### `DATABASE_SSL`

type `boolean` · default `false`

Use TLS for database connections (hosted Postgres). `sslmode` in the URL also works.

## Redis / Valkey

Cache and BullMQ queues.

### `REDIS_URL`

**required** · secret · type `url` · e.g. `redis://localhost:6379`

Redis connection string used for caching and bot state.

### `REDIS_QUEUE_URL`

secret · type `url` · default `$REDIS_URL`

Redis connection string used by BullMQ queues. Defaults to REDIS_URL.

## Authentication

better-auth, served by the API at `API_URL/auth/*`.

### `AUTH_SECRET`

**required** · secret · type `string(minLength=32)`

Secret used to sign sessions, cookies and encrypt 2FA secrets. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

### `ALLOW_SIGNUP`

type `enum(first-user, invite-only, open)` · default `first-user`

Who may create an account: - first-user: the first account can sign up, then only invited emails - invite-only: only emails with a pending team invite - open: anyone

### `AUTH_COOKIE_DOMAIN`

Cookie domain shared by the dashboard and the API (e.g. `example.com` for app.example.com + api.example.com). Derived from APP_URL/API_URL when unset.

### `AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`

Social sign-in providers; each is enabled when its id and secret are set. Redirect URL: API_URL/auth/callback/<provider>.

### `AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`

secret

### `AUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID`

### `AUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET`

secret

### `AUTH_APPLE_CLIENT_ID`

Apple Services ID and the signed client-secret JWT.

### `AUTH_APPLE_CLIENT_SECRET`

secret

### `AUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID`

### `AUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET`

secret

### `AUTH_MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID`

default `common`

Entra tenant id; `common` allows any Microsoft account.

## Storage

Local volume or any S3-compatible store.

### `STORAGE_DRIVER`

type `enum(local, s3)`

Where files live: `local` (a directory, the default) or `s3` (any S3-compatible store: AWS, R2, Garage, MinIO). Inferred as `s3` when S3_BUCKET is set. Buckets (vault, avatars, apps, institutions) are key prefixes inside the one store.

### `STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR`

default `./data/storage`

Directory for the local driver. Relative paths resolve against the repo root, so the API and worker share it in development. Mount a volume here in Docker.

### `STORAGE_MAX_UPLOAD_MB`

type `number` · default `100`

Largest file accepted by POST /files/upload, in megabytes.

### `S3_ENDPOINT`

type `url`

S3 API endpoint. Leave empty for AWS; set for R2/Garage/MinIO, e.g. https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com or http://garage:3900

### `S3_REGION`

default `us-east-1`

### `S3_BUCKET`

Bucket holding every Midday object. Setting it selects the s3 driver.

### `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID`

secret

### `S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`

secret

### `S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE`

type `boolean` · default `false`

Path-style addressing (http://host/bucket/key). Needed for Garage and MinIO.

### `S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT`

type `url`

Endpoint browsers can reach for presigned URLs. When unset, signed URLs are served through the API (use this when S3_ENDPOINT is a private address).

### `S3_PUBLIC_URL`

type `url`

Public base URL of the bucket (e.g. an R2 custom domain) used for public objects (avatars, app logos, institution logos). When unset, they are served by the API at /files/public/<key>.

## Mail

Outbound SMTP, inbound IMAP / webhook.

### `SMTP_URL`

secret · type `url`

SMTP connection string, see examples above.

### `MAIL_FROM`

Default From address, e.g. "Midday <noreply@example.com>". Defaults to noreply@ the host of APP_URL.

### `INBOX_EMAIL_DOMAIN`

Inbound email (forward receipts and invoices to a per-team address). Addresses look like <inboxId>@INBOX_EMAIL_DOMAIN, or INBOX_EMAIL_LOCAL_PART+<inboxId>@INBOX_EMAIL_DOMAIN when a local part is set (plus-addressing, for a single shared mailbox).

### `INBOX_EMAIL_LOCAL_PART`

### `IMAP_URL`

secret · type `url`

Inbound via IMAP polling (worker). Any IMAP mailbox works, e.g. imaps://user:pass@imap.example.com:993. Messages are matched to a team by recipient (To, Delivered-To, X-Original-To).

### `IMAP_MAILBOX`

default `INBOX`

### `IMAP_PROCESSED_MAILBOX`

Mailbox processed messages are moved to. Empty: only mark them as seen.

### `IMAP_POLL_INTERVAL`

type `number` · default `5`

Minutes between polls.

### `INBOX_WEBHOOK_USERNAME`

Basic-auth credentials for the optional inbound email (Postmark) webhook at /webhooks/inbox. Both must be set to enable it.

### `INBOX_WEBHOOK_PASSWORD`

secret

## AI (optional)

Disabled until a provider is configured. See docs/ai.md.

### `AI_PROVIDER`

type `enum(openai, openai-compatible, google, anthropic, mistral)`

AI is optional. With nothing configured, chat, insights, natural-language search, AI tax-rate lookup, document extraction and transaction enrichment are disabled (see packages/ai and packages/features).

Chat/fast/vision/extraction models come from one provider:

```
  openai             OpenAI (api.openai.com)
  openai-compatible  any OpenAI-style server (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, LiteLLM,
                     OpenRouter ...); needs AI_BASE_URL and AI_MODEL_CHAT
  google | anthropic | mistral
```

If AI_PROVIDER is unset it is inferred from the legacy key variables below (OPENAI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, MISTRAL_API_KEY, in that order), so existing deployments keep working.

### `AI_BASE_URL`

type `url`

Base URL for openai-compatible servers (e.g. http://ollama:11434/v1). Also usable to point openai/anthropic/google/mistral at a proxy.

### `AI_API_KEY`

secret

API key for AI_PROVIDER. Optional for local openai-compatible servers.

### `AI_MODEL_CHAT`

Model for chat and insights. Defaults per provider; required for openai-compatible.

### `AI_MODEL_FAST`

Small/cheap model for titles, search filters, enrichment, CSV mapping. Defaults to the provider's fast model, else AI_MODEL_CHAT.

### `AI_MODEL_VISION`

Vision-capable model for receipt/invoice extraction, document classification and image input. Defaults to the provider's vision model, else AI_MODEL_CHAT.

### `AI_MODEL_EXTRACTION`

Optional dedicated extraction model, tried before AI_MODEL_VISION.

### `AI_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER`

type `enum(openai, openai-compatible, google, anthropic, mistral)`

Embeddings are fixed at 768 dimensions (the DB columns are vector(768)). They default to AI_PROVIDER's embedding model but can come from another provider, e.g. Ollama `nomic-embed-text` (768 native) while chat uses OpenAI. Changing the embedding model makes existing embeddings stale; see docs.

### `AI_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL`

type `url`

### `AI_EMBEDDING_API_KEY`

secret

### `AI_EMBEDDING_MODEL`

### `OPENAI_API_KEY`

secret

Legacy per-vendor keys. Only used to infer AI_PROVIDER / AI_API_KEY when those are unset. Prefer the AI_* variables above.

### `GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY`

secret

### `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`

secret

### `MISTRAL_API_KEY`

secret

## Banking (optional)

Each provider is enabled when its keys are set.

### `PLAID_CLIENT_ID`

Plaid: the free Trial plan includes 10 production Items.

Docs: https://dashboard.plaid.com/developers/keys

### `PLAID_SECRET`

secret

### `PLAID_ENVIRONMENT`

type `enum(sandbox, development, production)` · default `production`

Plaid environment, used by the API and Plaid Link in the browser.

### `SIMPLEFIN_ENABLED`

type `boolean` · default `false`

Enable SimpleFIN Bridge (US/CA, https://www.simplefin.org). Users paste a setup token from their bridge account (about $15-25/year, billed by SimpleFIN); no server-side keys are needed.

### `ENABLEBANKING_APPLICATION_ID`

Enable Banking (EU/UK). Create an app at https://enablebanking.com/cp/applications and use restricted production mode to link your own accounts for free.

### `ENABLE_BANKING_KEY_CONTENT`

secret

PEM private key for the Enable Banking application.

### `ENABLEBANKING_REDIRECT_URL`

type `url`

Defaults to $APP_URL/api/enablebanking/session when unset.

### `TELLER_APPLICATION_ID`

Teller application id (used by Teller Connect in the browser).

### `TELLER_ENVIRONMENT`

type `enum(sandbox, development, production)`

### `TELLER_CERT_BASE64`

secret

Base64-encoded Teller client certificate and key.

### `TELLER_KEY_BASE64`

secret

### `TELLER_SIGNING_SECRET`

secret

### `LOGO_DEV_TOKEN`

logo.dev publishable token used for institution/company logos. Optional: without it, logos fall back to initials avatars.

### `EXCHANGE_RATES_URL`

type `url` · default `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fawazahmed0/currency-api@latest/v1`

Base URL of the exchange-rates dataset (fawazahmed0 currency-api layout).

## Per-service settings

Keys read by a single app (ports, rate limits, job-board credentials, kill switches).

### `PORT`

type `port` · default `3003`

HTTP port.

Declared in `apps/api/.env.schema`.

### `API_RATE_LIMIT`

type `number` · default `1000`

Requests per window for the REST API / MCP / chat endpoints.

Declared in `apps/api/.env.schema`.

### `MCP_API_RATE_LIMIT`

type `number`

Defaults to API_RATE_LIMIT.

Declared in `apps/api/.env.schema`.

### `CHAT_RATE_LIMIT`

type `number` · default `100`

Declared in `apps/api/.env.schema`.

### `DB_POOL_STATS_INTERVAL_MS`

type `number` · default `60000`

Interval for logging DB pool stats (0 disables).

Declared in `apps/api/.env.schema`.

### `GITHUB_RELEASE_TOKEN`

secret

GitHub token for the desktop updater release proxy (higher rate limits).

Declared in `apps/api/.env.schema`.

### `BOARD_USERNAME`

Basic-auth credentials for the job board at /admin.

Declared in `apps/worker/.env.schema`.

### `BOARD_PASSWORD`

secret

Declared in `apps/worker/.env.schema`.

### `INSIGHTS_ENABLED`

type `boolean` · default `false`

Weekly AI insights generation and notification emails.

Declared in `apps/worker/.env.schema`.

### `INSIGHTS_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED`

type `boolean` · default `false`

Declared in `apps/worker/.env.schema`.

### `DISABLE_RECURRING_INVOICES`

type `boolean` · default `false`

Kill switches for scheduled invoice jobs.

Declared in `apps/worker/.env.schema`.

### `DISABLE_UPCOMING_NOTIFICATIONS`

type `boolean` · default `false`

Declared in `apps/worker/.env.schema`.

### `DATABASE_POOL_MAX`

type `number`

Max connections in the main (api) pool. Defaults to 8 in development, 20 otherwise.

Declared in `packages/db/.env.schema`.

### `DB_POOL_EVENT_LOGGING`

type `boolean` · default `false`

Log pg pool connect/acquire/remove events.

Declared in `packages/db/.env.schema`.

### `DEBUG_PERF`

type `boolean` · default `false`

Log per-request DB timing (also used by apps/api middleware).

Declared in `packages/db/.env.schema`.

### `MATCH_AUTO_ENABLED`

type `boolean` · default `false`

Auto-match inbox items to transactions above the confidence threshold.

Declared in `packages/db/.env.schema`.

### `TEST_DATABASE_URL`

secret · type `url`

Postgres used by DB integration tests (skipped when unset).

Declared in `packages/db/.env.schema`.

### `INSIGHTS_ENABLED_TEAM_IDS`

Comma-separated team ids allowed to receive insights (all teams when unset).

Declared in `packages/insights/.env.schema`.
